Four chords, **C, Am, F and G**, are under more pop songs than any other progression: I, vi, IV, V.
It can sound plain, and it can sound rich, depending on what the players do to it. Almost every
move is one of four: add a note to each chord, walk the bass between chords, approach a chord with
its own dominant, or split a bar into a two-five. This lesson adds those moves one at a time, on
the same four bars. The site's backing band plays every chart on this page, so you can hear each
change as it arrives.

**How to use the page.** Press ▶ on any chart and the band plays four choruses after a one-bar
count-in. The bar that is sounding lights up. The strip at the bottom of the window sets the key,
the feel, the tempo and the chord instrument for the whole page, and you can change them while the
band plays. Under every chord is its Roman numeral, which stays the same in every key. (The
numerals only name the chord's root, so a **III7** in bar 1 is the dominant of Am, and a **vii7**
before it is its two.)

## 1. The basic changes

One bar each of **I**, **vi**, **IV** and **V**. Plain major and minor triads. The bass moves
down a minor third, then down a third, then up a step, and the G at the end pulls back to the C.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="basic"></div>

Learn this version first. Every other version on the page is this one with something added, so
you should be able to hear the plain one underneath.

## 2. Add extensions

Extensions are notes added on top of the triad without changing what the chord *is*. **Cadd9**
adds a D. **Am7** adds a G, and **Fadd9** adds a G. **Gsus2** takes out the B and puts in an A,
so the chord has no third: it is neither major nor minor. It sounds suspended, and the
ordinary **G** that follows it, or the C it leads to, feels like the answer.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="ext"></div>

Use **Hear it without the changes** to compare with the chart before. The shaded bars are the
ones that differ. Listen to bar 4: the leading tone B, which is what pulls G to C, is not there.

## 3. Add passing chords

Two bars are split in half, so that the bass can walk instead of jump.

- **Bar 1: C, G/B.** The bass steps down C, B and arrives on A in bar 2. The **G/B** is a G chord
  with its third in the bass.
- **Bar 2: Am, C/G.** The bass keeps stepping down, A then G, to land on F in bar 3.
- **Bar 3: F, F♯dim.** Now the bass goes up, F, F♯, and arrives on G in bar 4. The **F♯dim** is
  built from F♯, A and C, three of the four notes of D7, so it pulls up to G.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="pass"></div>

Listen to the bass. There is no jump anywhere in the line: every note is one step from the last.
A slash chord such as **C/G** is the C chord with G as its lowest note.

## 4. Secondary dominants

A dominant seventh chord pulls to the chord a fifth below it. The home key has one, G7, which
pulls to C. A **secondary dominant** is the dominant of some other chord of the key, played just
before that chord, so that chord gets to sound like home for a moment.

- **E7** goes to Am. It has a G♯, which is not in the key of C.
- **C7** goes to F. It has a B♭, which is not in the key of C either.
- **D7** goes to G. It has an F♯.
- **G7** goes to C: the usual dominant, now with its seventh.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="sec"></div>

Each bar now has a note from outside the key, and each of them leads by half step into the next
bar's chord (G♯ to A, B♭ to A, F♯ to G). That is why the progression sounds like it is travelling.

## 5. ii-V-Is

A dominant can have a chord in front of it, the **ii** chord, a fifth above, so that the
approach itself is a progression: ii, V, then I. Here each secondary dominant gets its own two.

- **Bar 1** keeps C for two beats, then **Bm7 E7**, a two-five into Am.
- **Bar 2** keeps Am for two beats, then **Gm7 C7**, a two-five into F.
- **Bar 3** is **Fmaj7** for two beats, then **Am7 D7**, a two-five into G.
- **Bar 4** stays on **G7**.

<div class="bl-step" data-step="twofive"></div>

Strictly, the two-five into a minor chord uses a half-diminished ii (Bm7♭5), but plain Bm7 is the
common way to write it in pop and the band plays it as written. Compare the last chord of each of
the first three bars with section 4: it is the same dominant, with a two in front.

## Build your own chorus

Choose one option for each bar and the chart rewrites itself. Change a menu while the band is
playing and the new chords come in at the next bar. All of the options fit together, so there is
no wrong combination: try a plain first bar with a busy last bar, or the reverse.

<div id="bl-builder" class="bl-widget"></div>

## Test your ear

The band plays the plain four bars with one bar changed. The question tells you which bar to
listen to. Pick what you heard.

<div id="bl-quiz" class="bl-widget"></div>

## Where to go next

- Play along. Set the strip at the bottom to **Loop**, pick a key and play or sing over each
  version in turn. The bars with new chords are the ones that ask for new notes.
- Take a chorus you built to **Tools → Backing Track** (use *Copy as ABC* above and paste it
  into *Edit the changes (ABC)* there) to choose the bass line, comping rhythm and drum groove.
- Learn each version in the keys you play most: C, G, D and A for guitar and voice.

```{=html}
<script>
// The pop-changes lesson: every chart on the page is drawn by TuneChart and played by the Backing Track band
// (BandPlayer with a BandCatalog style). Charts are written in C ("A B" = two chords in a bar, "A:2 B C" = A for
// two beats, then B and C for one each) and transposed, on the page and in the band, to the key chosen in the strip.
(function () {
  var cat = window.BandCatalog, H = window.BandHarmony;
  if (!cat || !H || !window.BandPlayer || !window.TuneChart) return;
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function el(tag, cls, text) { var e = document.createElement(tag); if (cls) e.className = cls; if (text != null) e.textContent = text; return e; }

  // `prev` = the version a step is compared with (its shaded bars, and the "without the changes" button)
  var STEPS = {
    basic:   { bars: 'C|Am|F|G' },
    ext:     { bars: 'Cadd9|Am7|Fadd9|Gsus2', prev: 'basic' },
    pass:    { bars: 'C G/B|Am C/G|F F#dim|G', prev: 'basic' },
    sec:     { bars: 'C E7|Am C7|F D7|G7', prev: 'pass' },
    twofive: { bars: 'C:2 Bm7 E7|Am:2 Gm7 C7|Fmaj7:2 Am7 D7|G7', prev: 'sec' }
  };
  // The builder and the ear test: one choice for each bar. The first of each is the basic version.
  var SLOTS = [
    { from: 0, opts: [['Plain', 'C'], ['Add a ninth', 'Cadd9'], ['Passing chord', 'C G/B'], ['Dominant of vi', 'C E7'], ['Two-five into vi', 'C:2 Bm7 E7']] },
    { from: 1, opts: [['Plain', 'Am'], ['Add a seventh', 'Am7'], ['Passing chord', 'Am C/G'], ['Dominant of IV', 'Am C7'], ['Two-five into IV', 'Am:2 Gm7 C7']] },
    { from: 2, opts: [['Plain', 'F'], ['Add a ninth', 'Fadd9'], ['Passing chord', 'F F#dim'], ['Dominant of V', 'F D7'], ['Two-five into V', 'Fmaj7:2 Am7 D7']] },
    { from: 3, opts: [['Plain', 'G'], ['Suspended', 'Gsus2'], ['With its seventh', 'G7']] }
  ];
  var FEELS = [{ id: 'pop', label: 'Piano ballad', tempo: 76 }, { id: 'strum', label: 'Acoustic strum', tempo: 100 }, { id: 'motown', label: 'Motown / soul', tempo: 110 }, { id: 'swing', label: 'Medium swing', tempo: 120 }];
  var KEYS = ['C', 'D♭', 'D', 'E♭', 'E', 'F', 'G♭', 'G', 'A♭', 'A', 'B♭', 'B'], SHARP = { 2: 1, 4: 1, 7: 1, 9: 1, 11: 1 };
  var state = { key: 0, feel: 'pop', tempo: 76, inst: 'piano', loop: false };

  function split(s) { return s.split('|'); }
  // one bar: chords separated by spaces, "C:2" = two beats; chords without a length share what is left
  function barAbc(b) {
    var cs = b.split(' '), fixed = 0, free = 0;
    cs.forEach(function (c) { var m = /:(\d)$/.exec(c); if (m) fixed += +m[1]; else free++; });
    var each = free ? (4 - fixed) / free : 0;
    return cs.map(function (c) { var m = /^(.*):(\d)$/.exec(c), n = m ? +m[2] : each; return '"' + (m ? m[1] : c) + '"z' + n; }).join(' ');
  }
  function plain(c) { return c.replace(/:\d$/, ''); }
  function abcOf(bars) { return 'X:1\nT:Changes\nM:4/4\nL:1/4\nK:C\n' + bars.map(barAbc).join(' | ') + ' |]'; }
  function numerals(bars) { return bars.map(function (b) { return b.split(' ').map(function (c) { return H.roman(plain(c), 0); }).join(' '); }).join(' | '); }
  function semis() { var d = state.key; return d > 6 ? d - 12 : d; }
  function band() {
    var so = cat.styleOpts(state.feel, state.inst === 'guitar' ? 'guitar' : 'piano'), opts = Object.assign({}, so.opts, { variation: 0.5 }), need = so.instruments.slice();
    if (state.inst === 'organ') { opts.compSound = 'hammond'; need[1] = 'hammond'; }
    return { opts: opts, instruments: need };
  }

  // ---- a chart that follows the key and shades some of its bars ----
  var charts = [];
  function makeChart(host, bars, marked) {
    var c = { bars: bars, marked: marked || [] }, inner = el('div'), sh = el('div', 'bl-staff'); host.appendChild(inner); host.appendChild(sh);
    c.staff = window.LessonChordStaff ? LessonChordStaff.create(sh, { bars: bars, tonic: 0, transpose: semis(), flats: !SHARP[state.key] }) : null;
    c.chart = TuneChart.render(inner, abcOf(bars), { header: false, barsPerRow: 4, roman: 'both', romanFn: H.roman, transpose: semis(), preferFlats: !SHARP[state.key] });
    c.mark = function () { c.chart.barEls.forEach(function (b, i) { b.classList.toggle('bl-new', c.marked.indexOf(i) >= 0); }); };
    c.set = function (bars, marked) { c.bars = bars; c.marked = marked || []; c.chart.setTune(abcOf(bars)); c.mark(); if (c.staff) c.staff.set(bars); };
    c.setLive = function (i) { c.chart.setLive(i); if (c.staff) c.staff.light(i); };
    c.rekey = function () { c.chart.setTranspose(semis(), !SHARP[state.key]); c.mark(); if (c.staff) c.staff.rekey(semis(), !SHARP[state.key]); };
    c.mark(); charts.push(c); return c;
  }

  // ---- one band for the page ----
  var player = null, now = null;                               // now = { btn, label, view } of what is playing
  function status(t) { $('bl-status').textContent = t || ''; }
  function idle() {
    if (now) { now.btn.textContent = now.label; now.btn.classList.remove('bl-on'); if (now.view) now.view.setLive(-1); now = null; }
    $('bl-stop').disabled = true; status('');
  }
  function stop() { if (player) { try { player.stop(); } catch (e) {} } idle(); }
  function play(btn, view, bars) {
    var same = now && now.btn === btn; stop(); if (same) return;
    var parsed = TuneChart.parse(abcOf(bars)), b = band();
    if (!player) player = window.BandPlayer.create({ parsed: parsed, tempo: state.tempo, transpose: semis(), countIn: 1, opts: b.opts, instruments: b.instruments,
      onBar: function (info) { if (!now) return; status(info.countIn ? 'Count-in' : info.ending ? '' : 'Bar ' + (info.index + 1) + (state.loop ? '' : ', chorus ' + (info.chorus + 1) + ' of 4'));
        if (now.view) now.view.setLive(info.countIn || info.ending ? -1 : info.index); },
      onState: function (s) { if (s === 'loading') status('Loading the sounds…'); },
      onEnd: idle });
    else { player.setInstruments(b.instruments); player.setChart(parsed); player.setOpts(b.opts); player.setTempo(state.tempo); player.setTranspose(semis()); }
    player.setCycle(null, null); player.setStartBar(0);
    player.setChoruses(state.loop ? 0 : 4);
    now = { btn: btn, label: btn.textContent, view: view, bars: bars };
    btn.textContent = '■ Stop'; btn.classList.add('bl-on'); $('bl-stop').disabled = false;
    player.play().then(null, function () { idle(); status('The sounds could not be loaded.'); });
  }
  function playBtn(label, primary) { var b = el('button', 'btn btn-sm ' + (primary ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-outline-secondary'), label); b.type = 'button'; return b; }

  // ---- the numbered sections ----
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.bl-step'), function (host) {
    var s = STEPS[host.getAttribute('data-step')]; if (!s) return;
    var bars = split(s.bars), before = s.prev ? split(STEPS[s.prev].bars) : null;
    var changed = before ? bars.map(function (b, i) { return b !== before[i] ? i : -1; }).filter(function (i) { return i >= 0; }) : [];
    host.classList.add('bl-widget');
    var tools = el('div', 'bl-tools'), paper = el('div'); host.appendChild(tools); host.appendChild(paper);
    var view = makeChart(paper, bars, changed);
    var b1 = playBtn('▶ Play', true); b1.addEventListener('click', function () { play(b1, view, bars); }); tools.appendChild(b1);
    if (before) { var b2 = playBtn('▶ Hear it without the changes'); b2.addEventListener('click', function () { play(b2, view, before); }); tools.appendChild(b2); }
    if (changed.length) { var lg = el('p', 'bl-legend'); lg.appendChild(el('i')); lg.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Changed from the version before')); host.appendChild(lg); }
  });

  // ---- build your own ----
  function assemble(picks) { var out = []; SLOTS.forEach(function (sl, k) { out.push(sl.opts[picks[k]][1]); }); return out; }
  function optionLabel(o) { return o[0] + ':  ' + numerals([o[1]]); }
  (function () {
    var host = $('bl-builder'); if (!host) return;
    var picks = SLOTS.map(function () { return 0; }), grid = el('div', 'bl-slots'), tools = el('div', 'bl-tools'), paper = el('div'), sels = [];
    host.appendChild(grid); host.appendChild(tools); host.appendChild(paper);
    var view = makeChart(paper, assemble(picks), []);
    function marked() { var m = []; SLOTS.forEach(function (sl, k) { if (picks[k]) m.push(sl.from); }); return m; }
    function refresh() {
      view.set(assemble(picks), marked());
      if (now && now.view === view && player) player.setChart(TuneChart.parse(abcOf(view.bars)));
    }
    SLOTS.forEach(function (sl, k) {
      var wrap = el('div'), id = 'bl-slot-' + k, lab = el('label', null, 'Bar ' + (sl.from + 1)), sel = el('select', 'form-select form-select-sm');
      lab.htmlFor = id; sel.id = id;
      sl.opts.forEach(function (o, i) { var op = el('option', null, optionLabel(o)); op.value = i; sel.appendChild(op); });
      sel.addEventListener('change', function () { picks[k] = +sel.value; refresh(); });
      wrap.appendChild(lab); wrap.appendChild(sel); grid.appendChild(wrap); sels.push(sel);
    });
    function setAll(fn) { picks = SLOTS.map(fn); sels.forEach(function (s, k) { s.value = picks[k]; }); refresh(); }
    var go = playBtn('▶ Play', true); go.addEventListener('click', function () { play(go, view, view.bars); }); tools.appendChild(go);
    var rnd = playBtn('Surprise me'); rnd.addEventListener('click', function () { setAll(function (sl) { return Math.floor(Math.random() * sl.opts.length); }); }); tools.appendChild(rnd);
    var base = playBtn('Back to the basic changes'); base.addEventListener('click', function () { setAll(function () { return 0; }); }); tools.appendChild(base);
    var copy = playBtn('Copy as ABC'); tools.appendChild(copy);
    copy.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var text = abcOf(view.bars).replace('T:Changes', 'T:My changes (written in C)');
      var done = function (ok) { copy.textContent = ok ? 'Copied' : 'Could not copy'; setTimeout(function () { copy.textContent = 'Copy as ABC'; }, 1500); };
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { done(true); }, function () { done(false); }); else done(false);
    });
    var lg = el('p', 'bl-legend'); lg.appendChild(el('i')); lg.appendChild(document.createTextNode('Changed from the basic changes')); host.appendChild(lg);
  })();

  // ---- test your ear ----
  (function () {
    var host = $('bl-quiz'); if (!host) return;
    var tools = el('div', 'bl-tools'), ask = el('p', null, 'Press New question to begin.'), count = el('div', 'bl-count'), answers = el('div', 'bl-answers'),
        verdict = el('p', 'bl-verdict'), score = el('p', 'bl-score'), paper = el('div');
    [tools, ask, count, answers, verdict, score, paper].forEach(function (e) { host.appendChild(e); });
    paper.hidden = true; verdict.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    var boxes = []; for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { var d = el('div', null, String(i + 1)); count.appendChild(d); boxes.push(d); }
    var counter = { setLive: function (i) { boxes.forEach(function (b, k) { b.classList.toggle('bl-live', k === i); }); } };
    var q = null, right = 0, asked = 0, last = -1, reveal = null;
    var next = playBtn('New question', true), again = playBtn('▶ Hear it again'); again.disabled = true; tools.appendChild(next); tools.appendChild(again);
    function listen() { if (q) play(again, counter, q.bars); }
    again.addEventListener('click', listen);
    next.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var k; do { k = Math.floor(Math.random() * SLOTS.length); } while (k === last); last = k;
      var sl = SLOTS[k], picks = SLOTS.map(function () { return 0; }); picks[k] = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * (sl.opts.length - 1));
      q = { slot: k, pick: picks[k], bars: assemble(picks), done: false };
      ask.textContent = 'Listen to bar ' + (sl.from + 1) + '. Which do you hear?';
      boxes.forEach(function (b, i) { b.classList.toggle('bl-ask', i === sl.from); });
      answers.textContent = ''; verdict.textContent = ''; paper.hidden = true; again.disabled = false;
      sl.opts.forEach(function (o, i) {
        var b = el('button', 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary', optionLabel(o)); b.type = 'button';
        b.addEventListener('click', function () {
          if (q.done) return; q.done = true; asked++;
          var ok = i === q.pick; if (ok) right++; else b.classList.add('bl-wrong');
          answers.children[q.pick].classList.add('bl-right');
          verdict.textContent = ok ? 'Yes.' : 'Not this time. The band played "' + sl.opts[q.pick][0] + '".';
          score.textContent = right + ' right out of ' + asked;
          paper.hidden = false;
          if (!reveal) reveal = makeChart(paper, q.bars, [sl.from]); else reveal.set(q.bars, [sl.from]);
        });
        answers.appendChild(b);
      });
      if (now && now.btn === again) stop();
      listen();
    });
  })();

  // ---- the strip at the bottom ----
  KEYS.forEach(function (k, i) { var o = el('option', null, k); o.value = i; $('bl-key').appendChild(o); });
  FEELS.forEach(function (f) { var o = el('option', null, f.label); o.value = f.id; $('bl-feel').appendChild(o); });
  function showTempo() { $('bl-tempo').value = state.tempo; $('bl-tempo-n').value = state.tempo; }
  function setTempo(v) { v = Math.max(40, Math.min(220, Math.round(+v) || state.tempo)); state.tempo = v; showTempo(); if (player) player.setTempo(v); }
  function setBand() { if (!player) return; var b = band(); player.setInstruments(b.instruments); player.setOpts(b.opts); }
  $('bl-key').value = state.key; $('bl-feel').value = state.feel; showTempo();
  $('bl-key').addEventListener('change', function () { state.key = +this.value; charts.forEach(function (c) { c.rekey(); }); if (player) player.setTranspose(semis()); });
  $('bl-feel').addEventListener('change', function () { state.feel = this.value; var f = FEELS.filter(function (x) { return x.id === state.feel; })[0]; setBand(); setTempo(f.tempo); });
  $('bl-inst').addEventListener('change', function () { state.inst = this.value; setBand(); });
  $('bl-tempo').addEventListener('input', function () { setTempo(this.value); });
  $('bl-tempo-n').addEventListener('change', function () { setTempo(this.value); });
  $('bl-loop').addEventListener('change', function () { state.loop = this.checked; if (player && now) player.setChoruses(state.loop ? 0 : 4); });
  $('bl-stop').addEventListener('click', stop);
})();
</script>
```
